## Scope check

- [ ] The request keeps existing `eloop` command names, arguments, and JSON
      output backward compatible.
- [ ] The request does not require uploading raw artifacts or calling remote
      services.
- [ ] The request can be implemented with the Python standard library.
- [ ] The request does not add data to evidence summaries that belongs in raw
      artifacts.
